title: Repeat Travel Credit Multiples for Superhosts — Host Accounts
content:
# Superhost Perk Schedule — Base Amount of a Repeat Travel Credit (Host Accounts)

The base amount of a Superhost's Roamhaven travel credit on Host Accounts is set by the travel credits the host already holds:

| Earlier travel credits already booked on the host account | Base amount of the new credit |
|---|---|
| At least two | 1.5 times the tier's travel credit amount |
| Exactly one | 1.25 times the tier's travel credit amount |
| None | No multiple applies |

Each multiple is rounded half up to the cent.

An earlier travel credit is a travel credit already booked on the host's account, whenever it was booked; the credit being worked out is not one of them.

## Illustrations (hypothetical tier amount of USD 100.00)

- A host with three earlier travel credits holds at least two: base amount USD 150.00.
- A host with exactly two: USD 150.00.
- A host with exactly one: USD 125.00.
- A host with none: no multiple applies.

With a hypothetical tier amount of USD 90.10, 1.25 times is USD 112.625, rounded half up to USD 112.63.
